name: phase_01_membership_email_hint
lock_risk: Adds one nullable text column without a default plus a NOT VALID-free check over the bounded Phase 01 membership fixture; PostgreSQL does not rewrite rows for the column addition, but the check takes a brief table lock and scans existing membership rows.
representative_data: Runs against empty, previous-version, and deterministic Phase 01 identity lanes; live authorization tests prove ordinary masked reads return null while the exact sensitive permission plus organization_administration purpose may return only the stored masked hint.
query_plan_review: The column is projected only after tenant, role, permission, purpose, assurance, authorization-version, resource-state, and cursor checks; no index or lookup by the hint is introduced.
space_risk: Stores an optional already-masked display hint copied from a hash-bound invitation. Raw or canonical email addresses, lookup digests, cookies, tokens, and arbitrary text are forbidden by design and tests.
forward_fix: Disable purpose-sensitive hint disclosure and add a new ordered migration for any constraint, retention, masking, or grant correction; existing null and masked values remain safe to retain.
rollback: Disable the optional disclosure path and continue returning null. Do not recover or synthesize raw email data, loosen authorization, or edit released migration 13.
